title: VST: Verifiable Structured Transport for Auditable Agent-to-Agent Alpha Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.07065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent-to-agent (A2A) alpha discovery is slowed by repeated feedback cycles between mining and evaluation agents, whose hand-offs, in contemporary LLM multi-agent systems, are free-form natural-language messages that carry no stable contract and cannot be replayed. We first restructure this communication as a structured agent-to-agent protocol of \emph{typed, causally addressable, unicast records}, so that the committed stream forms a causal trajectory. On that trajectory a single predictor with four typed heads forecasts the accumulated guidance the two miners would receive several cycles ahead; a transactional verify--leap controller then commits a multi-cycle speculative outcome only when it passes a four-level gate, and otherwise rolls back to the exact prior state. translated_title: VST：面向可审计智能体间Alpha发现的可验证结构化传输
translated_abstract: 智能体到智能体（A2A）的Alpha发现过程被挖掘智能体与评估智能体之间反复的反馈循环所拖慢。在当代基于LLM的多智能体系统中，这些智能体之间的交接采用自由形式的自然语言消息，既不携带稳定的契约，也无法被重放。我们首先将这种通信重构为一种由类型化、因果可寻址、单播记录组成的结构化智能体间协议，使得已提交的记录流形成一条因果轨迹。在该轨迹上，一个具有四个类型化输出头的单一预测器可以提前多个循环预测两个挖掘智能体将累积收到的指导信息；随后，一个事务性的“验证—跳跃”控制器仅当预测通过四级门控检验时才提交多循环的投机性结果，否则回滚到精确的先前状态。结构化设计是本文的核心使能贡献，其价值并不体现在精度上。一项受控消融实验表明，等信息的自由文本通道可以达到与该预测器相同的命中率……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出可验证结构化传输协议VST，将智能体间自由文本通信重构为类型化、因果可寻址的单播记录流，并借助四级门控的事务性预测—回滚控制器实现可审计、可重放的多循环投机执行，从而加速智能体间Alpha发现。
en_tdlr: VST restructures free-form agent-to-agent communication into typed, causally addressable unicast records with a transactional verify-leap controller, enabling auditable, replayable multi-cycle speculative execution to accelerate agent-to-agent alpha discovery.
